The place value of F is 6

The place value of O is 15

Similarly,

The place value of U is 21

TUB = (20 + 21 + 2) × 2 = 86

Hence, “86” is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is a folk painting form of Bihar?
questions.solution:
• **Madhubani painting** is a folk painting from **Bihar**. 
 
• Madhubani is a traditional Indian folk art made on canvas, cloth or washed hand paper.

 
• It is also known as Mithila painting due to its origins in the Mithila region of Bihar, India, and Nepal.

 
• Natural dye and colors are used in the creation of Madhubani artworks with geometrical figures and vibrant colors being key elements. 

 
• They paint pictures of nature and mythology to depict different events like birth, marriage, and cycles of life.

questions.question: Blood in urine or stool can be caused by the deficiency of which of the following vitamin?
questions.solution:
• Deficiency of **vitamin K **can cause excessive bleeding, which may start from the nose or gums, include easy bruising, blood in urine and stools.
 
• **Vitamin K **is known as the **“blood-clotting vitamin”** for its important role in healing wounds. 
 
• **Vitamin K **also plays an important role in **bone health.** 
 
• Vitamin K deficiency bleeding is a problem that occurs in some newborn babies. This condition is called **hemorrhagic disease.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold an article for Rs. 540 at some profit. Had he sold it for Rs. 470, then there would have been a loss equal to one-sixth of the initial profit. What was the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
Let the CP of the article be Rs. x, and the initial profit be P

We know, Profit P = Selling Price - Cost Price

and Loss = Cost Price - Selling Price

According to the question

Loss = 1/6 × P = x - 470 or P = 6x - 2820 ---- (i)

Profit = P = 540 - x ---- (ii)

From (i) and (ii)

540 – x = 6x – 2820

6x + x = 2820 + 540

7x = 3360

x = 3360/7

x = 480 = Cost price

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Using hit and trial, we need to find if the loss is 1/6th of the profit

Give that SP₁ = 540 and SP₂ = 470

Let us assume that CP is Rs. 480 

So Profit = SP - CP = 540 - 480 = Rs. 60

1/6th of 60 = 10 and 480 - 470 = 10

Hence, our assumption is correct and C.P = Rs. 480

Average of last six numbers = 49.5

Sum of 6th, 7th and 8th number is = 644 – 215 – 297 = 132

Sixth and seventh numbers are (x + 4) and (x + 8) respectively.

x + 4 + x + 8 + x = 132

3x + 12 = 132

3x = 132 – 12

x = 120/3

x = 40

Sixth number = 40 + 4 = 44

Seventh number = 40 + 8 = 48

Average of sixth and seventh numbers = (44 + 48)/2 = 46

questions.question: If each side of a rectangular field is increased by 32%, then by how much percent does the area of the field increase?
questions.solution:
**Short trick:**

32 + 32 + [(32 × 32)/100] = 64 + 10.24 = 74.24%

**Detailed Method:**

Let length and breadth of the rectangle be x cm and y cm respectively, then

Area of rectangle = length × breadth = xy cm²
New length of the rectangle = x × (132/100) = 1.32x cm

New breadth of the rectangle y × (132/100) = 1.32y cm

New area of the rectangle = 1.32x × 1.32y = 1.7424xy cm²

Area increased by = 1.7424xy – xy = 0.7424xy

Required percentage = [0.7424xy/xy] × 100 = 74.24%
